about: The savings map in words. The console (SavingsMap.tsx on Overview) and the faxbot command (faxbot costs mechanisms, cli/commands/delivery.py mechanism_lines) both show exactly what the server says. The response is GET /routing/savings/mechanisms evaluated on a real synthetic installation (api/tests/test_savings_mechanisms.py scenario); its catalogue fields must match app/routing/mechanisms.py.

response.title: How Faxbot saves money
response.sentence: Every way Faxbot saves money, in the order a fax meets them.

legend.label: On or Off
legend.sentence: Whether it is switched on for your faxes.

legend.sentence: Whether this installation has what it needs, such as its own phone line or a partner.

legend.label: Tested
